title: Optimal Lunar Flyby using Multiple Shooting
provenance: Current script-based Help program listings entered through the GUI with QtTest keyboard events. No completed example mission is read to generate this recipe. Output/data paths are isolated to this case; dependencies are its own newly generated observations.
